rationale: The declaration bodies preserve the scoped source dataflow and indexing: Q_{i-1} is the left Riemann state, Q_i the right state, the origin remains unspecified, solver information produces the interface flux, and cell i is updated from its right-minus-left flux difference. Exact physical-flux equality is explicitly assumed, while the conservative update is a substantive concrete conclusion. The target is therefore an accepted faithful-stronger exact conservative subcase, with no claim about the out-of-scope typical similarity-wave structure.
